svg.aria-label: Van Nuys Airport: general and business aviation only — no scheduled commercial airlines.
svg.text: A private-aviation airport — there are no scheduled commercial airline terminals.
Private jets and charters operate through FBOs (fixed-base operators)
such as Signature, Clay Lacy, and Castle & Cooke — not airline gates.
Arriving by private jet? RideYeah meets you planeside at your FBO.
Schematic for orientation — not to scale. For FBO locations and access, see iflyvny.com.
